subject: Cooking
title: Shawarma: The Rotating Spit That Conquered the World
description: One-minute skill: Shawarma: The Rotating Spit That Conquered the World.

hook.text: A tower of meat rotates slowly next to a wall of fire. A knife shaves thin, crispy slices. That's shawarma.

buildup.text: The vertical spit technique originated in Ottoman Turkey as döner kebab — 'döner' means 'rotating.'

discovery.text: As the Ottoman Empire spread, so did the technique — becoming shawarma in Arabic, gyros in Greek, and al pastor in Mexico.

twist.text: Mexican al pastor uses the exact same vertical spit — brought by Lebanese immigrants to Mexico in the 1930s.

climax.text: Germany's döner kebab industry is worth €7 billion annually — it's the country's most popular fast food.

punchline.text: One Turkish cooking technique became five countries' national street food.

quiz.question: How did the shawarma technique reach Mexico?
